messages:
maya: Heads-up — Meridian Health private rollout: telemetry egress is flaking in staging. Need clear owner for validating telemetry path (metrics + traces) out of their air-gapped subnet. Tagging folks who touched this last week. @jon @samir :eyes:
jon: I saw the errors, looks like TLS handshake drops when the proxy rotates certs. Logs show repeated 502s from the telemetry-proxy pod.
samir: Can you paste the log snippet? I was looking at the registry sync earlier, might be related to image pull/backoff.
maya: Paste from staging telemetry-proxy: ```2026-02-12T18:04:21Z telemetry-proxy ERROR upstream connect failed: tls: remote error: tls: handshake failure```
lina: That's the same stack we hit on Quietbridge last month — proxy config + SNI mismatch. Who maintains the proxy config for Meridian?
jon: That should be dave/team-ops, but last config edit was by me for the cert rotation. I can meet halfway. dave — can you confirm the SNI cert names and that the egress NAT preserves SNI?
dave: Confirmed NAT preserves SNI. Meridian's proxy expects common name `meridian-telemetry.redwood-corp` — cert rotation on our side issued `meridian-telemetry-v2`. Fallback works intermittently because some clients accept SAN while others strictly check CN.
ops: infra-bot triggered runbook suggestion: see https://runbooks.redwood.internal/onprem/telemetry-egress-checklist (access required).
infra-bot: Runbook snippet: "Step 3: verify proxy CN and SAN with `openssl s_client -connect <proxy>:443 -servername <proxy-cn>`"
maya: Action items: (1) jon to open CR to align cert CN -> `meridian-telemetry.redwood-corp` (2) dave confirm proxy SAN includes both legacy and v2 names (3) samir to validate image sync/backoff is unrelated. Can we set owners and ETA?
jon: I'll open CR in a few mins. PR link will be posted here. ETA EOD PST.
dave: I'll update proxy SAN today and push a canary config to staging. Will ping infra for smoke.
samir: I'll run an image sync health check and post the results here by EOD. If backoff, I'll escalate to eng-infra.
lina: Also note firewall egress rule needs `10.24.0.0/14` allowed to telemetry endpoints — Meridian's network team asked for clarification. Sample rule: ```egress:
  - to: 52.23.45.0/24
    ports: [443]
  - to: 52.23.46.0/24
    ports: [443]
  - to: 10.24.0.0/14
    ports: [443]```
maya: Good catch. dave — can you confirm whether NAT + firewall on their appliance will allow that block or we need explicit host entries?
dave: Meridian appliance only accepts prefix lists, so the /14 is fine. I'll add it to the config request.
jon: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra/meridian-cert-fix/pull/142 (draft). Linking CR review: @lina @samir please take a look.
lina: Reviewing now. Quick note: include a rollback plan in the PR (old cert key available, and config toggle).
samir: Added a quick smoke script I'll attach to the PR to validate TLS and egress: `scripts/check-telemetry-egress.sh`
maya: Nice. One more cross-team ask: product asked for a 2h canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PST. Can we schedule it if infra approves?
dave: 09:00-11:00 PST works for me. I'll coordinate with Meridian ops to be on-call.
ops: Marking owners: jon (cert CR), dave (proxy + SAN + firewall), samir (image sync + smoke script), lina (CR review + rollback). I'll update the rollout tracker.
maya: Thanks — I'll update the customer and close the loop once the PR + canary are green. :thumbsup:
